coreStatisticsPolicy: All-situation regular-season totals from the summary report. Team abbreviations describe season affiliations, not current roster membership.
note: Individual PP points/game and team on-ice PP goals/game both use all recorded games played as the denominator. Baselines include only players with at least 75 PP minutes. Team on-ice PP goals/game is descriptive context only and does not contribute to the offensive rating.
